quest.title: Hyperion's Dirge
quest.description: According to the spirit named Aberaku, he can only find peace if you collect the three fragments of his soul and reunite them with the main body...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler from another land, it is you.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, my soul has become whole, and I now recall everything. Incredible.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Perhaps you already know that in the distant past, there was only a great darkness in Byakuyakoku, and that those who lived there dwelt in fear of the Dragonheirs of the Depths.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Back then, it was I who organized the construction of the Dainichi Mikoshi, and thus did Byakuyakoku obtain a cyclical night and day, and thus did the name "Byakuya" come about.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: It was said that: "Now that the Dainichi Mikoshi has been built, though this land is in everlasting night, we can at least tell black from white."

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: How mortifying then, that before the shreds of my soul were reunited, I could not even remember that day when the people crowded around the completed Dainichi Mikoshi.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: It should have been my fondest memory.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: But alas...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alas what?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: When Dainichi Mikoshi was built, the Dragonheirs were defeated, repelled by a light that they were unused to. Thus did the people regain peace of mind.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: But the moment peace began to reign... Ah, the human heart is hard to comprehend. Who knew then that they would have begun to nurse such evil intent?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: O Traveler from afar, I am certain that you know how voracious villains will seize for themselves riches and power if given the chance... more than they ever deserved!

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: And so they used the people, leading them unto the worship of the Dainichi Mikoshi, leading them into the folly of believing in such vain and dead objects.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: In the end, they even proclaimed the rule of the "Sunc{RUBY#[S]Phaethon}hild" over the land.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Sunchild?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Indeed. There will always be a young infant chosen to be the Sunchild.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Of course, such children would not have been of age to understand the world. They would not have been fit to rule. And so they served as puppets, going along with those who pulled their strings in the background.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: I wanted to oppose this, but I was accused of high treason by the Sunchild under their control and imprisoned here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, the Sunchild...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But wouldn't the Sunchild eventually realize that they were being manipulated?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: And that is why no Sunchild has ever reached maturity. For it is as you say: grown people are not so easily swayed by villains.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: "The hallowed Sunchild, their birth-rite begun, on Pegasus shall ride to the feast of the sun."

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Yes. They would be taken to the inner sanctum of the Dainichi Mikoshi, dressed up as those attending birth rites and in high spirits...

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: ...The thing hidden here is related to them.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: This bridle is the proof that one is indeed a child of the sun. I hid it here, thinking to someday hand it over and alert the people... But I suppose that such a deed is meaningless now.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Traveler from another land... I was neither able to protect those children nor this nation.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: My name is...

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Aberaku, Helios-Forger!

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: I organized the construction of the Dainichi Mikoshi. 'Twas I who hung a bright mirror on high amidst the ever-night, and I thought myself a genius.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: And such talent I had! Such ability!

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: I dreamed of using the Dainichi Mikoshi to wash away the darkness, but I did not then know that it was the greed and desire within human hearts that was the all-devouring night everlasting.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Guest from afar, I now give the bridle into your hands.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: This Divine Bridle is a testament to our supremely laughable history...

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Keep it well... Nay, do with it whatever you wish.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is too precious a gift...

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Hah! Nay, it has already been rendered meaningless. That I have been restored to wholeness and become able to hand it to you is fate. And for this thing, it shall be considered a fine death.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Ah... All the talent, all the ability...

choices.text: So, on one of their birthdays...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Please, claim the offerings at The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and the Serpent's Heart. This way, my soul shall be reunited, and I shall be able to open the way to the Dainichi Mikoshi for you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The offering's done...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Earlier, that soul remnant said that the offerings could open the way to Dainichi Mikoshi...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go up and have a look, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The offering's done...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Earlier, that soul remnant said that the offerings could open the way to Dainichi Mikoshi...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go up and have a look, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: My name is...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Aberaku, Helios-Forger!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Paimon's... well, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, since he started it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess it's just good manners.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: It is but a small matter. Indeed, it is I who has treated you with utter disregard, having come to receive you in such a tragic state.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Don't worry! We don't mind. Right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, why are you here, Mister?

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: I... I am the creator of the Helios, and this place is my... final resting place.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Falling asleep in a dark, icy place, never to wake... How could I just die like that? I, the Helios-Forger!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The creator of the Helios?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's the Helios?

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Ah, right. Helios is what I called my creation in private.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Perhaps this is not known to you, but the people of Byakuyakoku call this thing...

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: The Dainichi Mikoshi.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Helios is the Dainichi Mikoshi, the solar chariot that drives the Hype{RUBY#[S]Byakuya no Hikari}rion.

choices.text: So you're the creator of the Dainichi Mikoshi?

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Indeed it is.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: O Traveler from another land. Though I did create it, I was placed under house arrest, and imprisoned above my own creation.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: After my death, my soul was scattered across the land of Byakuyakoku, and many of my memories were lost in that scattering.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: I remember that there was something very important... high above the Dainichi Mikoshi...

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: But I can no longer remember it. Please, distant wayfarer... Could you help me retrieve my clothes, crown, and bones, which have been placed in three different places?

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: You may find them in The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and the Serpent's Heart.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Offer them up upon the three altars, and my soul shall be reunited, and I shall be able to open the way to the Dainichi Mikoshi for you...

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Then you will be able to travel above the Dainichi Mikoshi, into the closed spaces hidden in the veil of ever-night.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: ...I see. So you are a guest from afar.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: I only regret that I have come to meet you in such a horrid state.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's alright!

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Please, claim the offerings at The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and the Serpent's Heart. This way, my soul shall be reunited, and I shall be able to open the way to the Dainichi Mikoshi for you...

talks.objective: Find and offer up the objects in which Aberaku nested his thoughts

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Ah... All the talent, all the ability... But what use was it?
